first_comment_note: owner 19 Nov: every news post gets the page's own first comment, made automatically (no approval) - source paper + article link, news date, why the page shares news, corrections / objections by DM (post.py SOURCE_COMMENT)

reel_voice_alt.note: owner 27 Oct: Google Charon reads EVERY reel, ONLY inside Google's free allowance (1 million characters a month); the code stops at 700,000 (safety margin: some usage records can be lost when posting jobs save at the same time), then Valluvar until the 1st; Valluvar also whenever Google fails. Never paid. Needs secret GOOGLE_TTS_API_KEY

prime_time.note: owner 19 Nov: posting time first (best reach; 19 Nov data, views against each page's median: 06-09 1.02, 09-12 1.12, 12-15 0.84, 15-18 1.02, 18-21 0.92, 21-24 0.80). News posts in 06:00-12:00 and 15:00-21:00 IST; collection is fitted to them (04:00, 08:30, 13:00, 16:30, 18:30) so every window opens with news ready and every news posts the same day. When a window opens every ready news posts at once, news written inside a window posts at once, news written outside waits for the next window (made ahead). Nothing is dropped; power cuts post at once; a news waiting 18 h posts anyway.

reel_punch_note: owner 27 Oct (change 1): every reel opens with a spoken punch line (yellow number + headline) while the big headline is on screen

reach.note: owner 29 Oct (views plan): each switch can be turned off here without code changes
reach.hashtag_note: owner 2 Nov: 5 tags, all from these fixed lists (never the writer's own tags): page + area + town (place_tags; a village maps to its town tag) + local topic (rain / power cut, else the page's news tag) + the Tamil place tag. A Rasipuram reel never carries a Namakkal page tag; no #TamilNews / #TamilNadu style tags

free_images.note: owner 30 Oct: pictures from free services first (Cloudflare -> Pollinations -> NVIDIA), FAL only when all fail

writers.note: owner 30 Oct: free writing models in this order; a provider without its key is skipped; Claude (paid) only after all of them. Gemma 4 is ready but NOT in the order: 30 Oct test on a real story gave 503 (high demand) / 500 - add "gemma" here once writer-compare proves it. power_cut.note: owner 19 Nov (same as every page): a power-cut reel reads EVERY area, so it may run to max_seconds (88 = 2 s under verify.py's 90 s check) with up to script_max_words; all other reels keep reel_max_seconds / reach.script_max_words

posting.note: owner 19 Nov: no gap between news posts - inside a posting window every ready news posts at once
